newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian shares higher in post-Amsterdam euphoria.
newsitem.headline: Italian shares higher in post-Amsterdam euphoria.

text.p: 0820 GMT - Italian shares opened mostly higher on Tuesday, swept by a wave of euphoria in the wake of an agreement among EU leaders in Amsterdam on a stability pact which has taken bonds to record highs.
* The all-share Mibtel index was 0.28 percent higher at 12,790 while the blue chip Mib30 index gained 0.34 percent to 19,348.
* Fiat rose 0.49 percent to 6,170 lire in the afterglow of Monday's shareholders meeting where company officials confirmed this year's strong industrial performance.
* Traders said that mark weakness was contributing to the buying frenzy. "The weak mark is helping us. That's rerally all there is to it," said a Milan-based stockbroker.
* ENI, due to go ex-dividend later this month, was stable at 9,240 lire while telecoms were almosyt unchanged. Mediaset slipped 0.41 percent to 7,270 lire.
* Banks were mostly weaker and insurers opened mixed. Milan newsroom +392-66102321
